page.overview:
What is Power Moons?

The , also simply known as is a main collectable found in Super Mario Odyssey. Power Moons are the equivalent of Power Stars and Shine Sprites from previous Mario games. There are more Moons in Super Mario Odyssey than Stars and Shines in previous games. Capping at a whopping 999 moons in total. Moons will also not force Mario to leave the level, unlike previous games.

When Mario collects a Multi Moon, it is worth as much as three normal Moons.

Each Moon is in the shape of a crescent moon or star with eyes, similar to that of Power Stars and Shine Sprites. Their color depends on which Kingdom the Moon is found. Each Kingdom's set of Moons have a different color than those of other Kingdoms.
